units.source_text: 女人被带走了，可绳梯还原封不动地吊在那里。

en.t: The woman had been taken away, but the rope ladder was still hanging there, untouched.

units.source_text: 男人战战兢兢伸出手去，悄悄地摸了一下，看看绳索还在不在。

en.t: The man reached out fearfully and touched it quietly, checking whether the rope was still there.

units.source_text: 于是，他慢慢地开始攀登。

en.t: Then he slowly began to climb.

units.source_text: 天空呈现出一片脏兮兮的黄色。

en.t: The sky had taken on a dirty yellow color.

units.source_text: 他像从水里爬上岸似的，手脚疲软而沉重。

en.t: As if he were crawling up onto shore from the water, his arms and legs felt weak and heavy.
... This was the rope ladder he had longed and longed for ...
